assets.rights: Original FPW chart derived from the illustrative worksheet in the versioned template.
assets.method: 120 illustrative nm / explicit knots = time; time × total vessel US gal/h = base burn; ×1.20 applies reserve once. Values calculated at full precision. Shared manifest inputs are not imported route mileage. Minutes rounded to nearest minute, matching visible worksheet. Vertical layout uses separate time and fuel scales.
assets.alternative: Visible calculation/comparison tables contain all inputs and results.
